title: Bathroom toothbrush and toothpaste organiser
author: sebastianm
description:
This bathroom organizer is printed on Bambu A1, designed for everyday use and made up of two parts – the outer body and an insert, which can be printed in different colors to better match the bathroom decor. The base of the organizer is covered with holes to make it easier for water from toothbrushes to drain away, helping to keep the inside dry and more hygienic. Its practical construction allows for convenient storage of toothbrushes, toothpaste, and other small items, keeping the area around the sink tidy.

If you like my design or you have any objective, please leave a comment, I would like to see your opinion.

bathroom organiser toothpaste and toothbrush holder
